value.description: Station class with level() method - needs optional datum parameter
Fleet class with level() method - needs optional datum parameter
summarise function - needs optional datum parameter
Existing test - should still pass after changes

value.station_level_signature: def level(self, reading_m: float) -> float: returns reading_m - self.datum_m
value.fleet_level_signature: def level(self, name: str, reading_m: float) -> float: delegates to station.level(reading_m)
value.summarise_signature: def summarise(fleet: Fleet, readings: dict) -> dict: calls fleet.level(name, value) for each reading
value.current_behavior: Station.level always uses self.datum_m; Fleet.level and summarise have no datum override option
value.change_plan: Add optional datum=None parameter to all three. When None, use station.datum_m (current behavior). When provided, use the override.
